story.overview:
As a Slack user interacting with Orion, I want responses to have consistent, professional visual formatting, so that information is easy to scan, looks polished, and maintains a cohesive brand experience.
Orion's response formatting has evolved organically across multiple stories, leading to inconsistencies: emoji inconsistency (some responses use emoji prefixes, others don't), header style variance (mix of *bold* headers and ## markdown which renders poorly in Slack), source/reference formatting variations, and stakeholder feedback that emoji-heavy formatting feels informal.
Key Design Decision (from Story 8.1): "Remove emojis from sources-block.ts - use *References:* header instead"

requirements.req: All response sections use *Section Name* format (Slack mrkdwn bold)
Remove markdown ## headers that render incorrectly in Slack
Header format: *Summary*, *Key Findings*, *References*, etc.
Consistent casing: Title Case for headers
Remove emoji prefixes from section headers in body text
Keep emoji ONLY for status indicators (searching, success, warning, error)
Response body text should be professional, not decorated with emojis
Exception: Status messages can use functional emojis per UX spec

emoji-policy.allowed: searching indicator, checkmark (success), warning, X (error) - Status messages only
emoji-policy.removed: magnifying glass, lightbulb, clipboard, wrench, lock, speech bubble, thread, group - No longer used

requirements.req: Create NEW file: src/slack/formatting-constants.ts (does not exist yet)
Define SECTION_HEADERS constant with all standard headers
Define RESPONSE_STRUCTURE constant for response ordering
Export constants for use across all formatters
NOTE: This is a NEW file to create, not an existing file to modify

All handlers use consistent response structure: 1) Lead with value (answer/result first), 2) Supporting details (bulleted), 3) References section (if sources exist), 4) Feedback prompt (if applicable)
Summarization responses follow same pattern
Error responses follow same pattern with alternatives
Audit src/tools/summarize/format-summary.ts - update to use formatting constants
Audit src/tools/summarize/generate-summary.ts - update prompt for consistent headers
Audit src/slack/handlers/user-message.ts response formatting
Audit src/slack/handlers/app-mention.ts response formatting
Audit any prompt templates that include formatting instructions
DO NOT modify src/slack/sources-block.ts - owned by Story 8.1
Remove emoji prefixes from summary sections (*Summary* not emoji+Summary)
Standardize section names: *Key Decisions*, *Action Items*, etc.
Update generate-summary.ts prompt to output consistent format
No new spans needed - formatting changes only
Verify existing traces still work after formatting changes

sources-block.ts changes - Story 8.1 owns the References/Sources block format
New response types - only polish existing ones

Custom UI components - Slack native only
